plain: Taken away by authority, as a penalty

webster.text: Adjudged to the public treasury, as forfeited goods or estate.

example.quote: It wd. exclude persons who had purchased confiscated property or should purchase Western territory of the public, and might be some obstacle to the sale of the latter.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 26, 1787
